name: B2B Portal Authentication (UAE PASS)
journey_path: Existing Business Customer Registering & Logging-on to B2B Portal
summary: User signs in to the B2B portal using UAE PASS authentication. The user clicks the UAE PASS button on the login screen, enters Emirates ID/email/mobile on the UAE PASS login screen, approves the request on the UAE PASS mobile app, and is redirected to the dashboard or organization selection screen.

steps.action: Navigate to the B2B Portal login page
steps.expected_result: The login page loads with the SIGN IN TO BUSINESS ONLINE panel
The Login to UAE PASS page opens

steps.action: Enter the Emirates ID, email address or UAE mobile number registered with UAE PASS

steps.expected_result: Approve Login Request opens with the number to select in the UAE PASS app

steps.action: Approve the login request in the UAE PASS app by selecting the number shown
steps.expected_result: The B2B portal refreshes and shows 'Authentication in Progress'

steps.action: Wait while the portal authenticates the user via UAE PASS
steps.expected_result: 'Authentication in Progress' and 'You are being authenticated via UAE PASS.' are shown until sign-in completes
Either 'Select a Organization to continue' (no default organization) or the Organization Dashboard (default organization) is displayed

steps.action: Click Cancel Request instead of approving
steps.expected_result: The portal shows 'User Cancelled the login' with Sign in with UAE PASS and BACK TO LOGIN PAGE
The B2B Portal login page opens

open_questions: What is the exact error message displayed after cancellation?
What happens after the error message is displayed? Does the user return to the login screen or stay on the confirmation screen?
Is there a loading or intermediate screen between approval and the dashboard/select organization screen?
